name: Key Rewards Visa

fx_fee.notes: Capital One states that it doesn't charge foreign transaction fees on any of its U.S.-issued credit cards.

base_rate.description: Up to 5% back in rewards; the official listing does not break the rate down by merchant.

rewards.redemption_notes: Intro 10% back on in-store purchases per the official listing.

notes: Williams-Sonoma family Key Rewards Visa issued by Capital One, listed on Capital One's credit card catalog with a $0 annual fee, up to 5% back in rewards and intro 10% back on in-store purchases. The catalog also lists brand versions (Pottery Barn, Williams Sonoma, West Elm); this record covers the unbranded Key Rewards Visa. No product page with the full earn structure or APR was found, so those fields are null. network_tier is recorded as none because the listing does not name the Visa package.
